payout_quote: Harris County jurors are paid $30 for the first day and $58 per day for each day after the first (Texas statutory minimums, effective Sept 1, 2023).
steps: Receive a Harris County jury summons
Receive $30 for day one and $58/day thereafter (may donate pay to charity via the donation form)
catches: You cannot volunteer — service is by summons only.
These are state minimums; the county sets the actual rate within the statutory range.
$58/day is well below typical daily wages.
biggest_catch: Summons-only; no way to sign up to earn this on demand.
eligibility: Persons summoned for jury service in Harris County, Texas.
timing: Paid per day of attendance; donation option via county form.

c1.evidence: Harris County District Clerk official juror form + Texas HB 2014 statutory minimums.
